cohort: Pregnant women at 37 weeks gestation or more with no contraindications to vaginal birth.
finding: Kiwi-assisted vaginal deliveries were associated with low rates of maternal (4.48%) and neonatal (7.98%) complications, with 95.7% of mothers reporting no pain after 10 days.
mod_finding: Kiwi-assisted vaginal delivery using the KIWI cup is presented as an excellent and safe alternative to cesarean section for eligible women, leading to decreased maternal and neonatal complications.
followup_time: Up to 10 days post-delivery (for some outcomes like pain)
